summary: Los Cabos, located at the southern tip of the Baja California Peninsula, is a world-class beach destination renowned for dramatic desert-meets-ocean landscapes, luxury resorts, and exceptional seafood dining. The region offers perfect conditions for water sports, golf, spa retreats, and stunning photography opportunities at iconic locations like El Arco and Medano Beach. Whether seeking relaxation or adventure, Los Cabos combines pristine coastal beauty with cosmopolitan amenities and vibrant Mexican culture.

restaurants.name: Mariscos Playa
restaurants.description: Casual beachfront seafood shack serving fresh ceviche, grilled fish, and shrimp tacos with ocean views. A local favorite offering authentic Baja flavors at budget-friendly prices.
restaurants.mustTry: Fish ceviche with fresh lime and cilantro

restaurants.name: Tótem Restaurant
restaurants.description: Contemporary Mexican cuisine featuring seasonal ingredients and traditional techniques in a vibrant, artistic setting. Known for creative ceviche presentations and regional specialties.

restaurants.name: Cabo Pulmo Seafood
restaurants.description: Family-run restaurant showcasing the daily catch from the nearby marine sanctuary, prepared simply to highlight fresh flavors. Outdoor seating with beach access.

restaurants.name: Flora Farms
restaurants.description: Farm-to-table dining experience featuring organic produce from their own gardens and sustainably sourced seafood. Elegant presentation and thoughtful wine pairings in a rustic-elegant setting.
restaurants.mustTry: Chef's tasting menu with local fish course

restaurants.name: Agua Caliente Taco Shop
restaurants.description: No-frills taco stand serving authentic Baja-style tacos including carnitas, al pastor, and fresh fish preparations. Perfect for quick, delicious meals.
restaurants.mustTry: Battered fish tacos with cabbage slaw

restaurants.name: Sunset Monalisa
restaurants.description: Beachfront Italian restaurant with sunset views, serving handmade pasta, fresh seafood, and thin-crust pizzas. Relaxed atmosphere perfect for evening dining.

restaurants.name: The Taco Stand
restaurants.description: Popular casual spot in downtown Cabo offering traditional Mexican breakfast and lunch items including chilaquiles, huevos rancheros, and fresh juices.
restaurants.mustTry: Breakfast burrito with chorizo and eggs

restaurants.name: Pitahayas
restaurants.description: Contemporary Mexican fine dining with French influences, housed in an elegant beachfront location. Featuring creative interpretations of traditional dishes with premium presentations.

restaurants.name: Medano Seafood Market
restaurants.description: Working seafood market with attached casual restaurant where fish is served within hours of landing. Direct, fresh, and authentically local experience.

restaurants.name: Cabo Wabo Cantina
restaurants.description: Celebrity-owned cantina in downtown Cabo offering Baja cuisine, live music, and vibrant nightlife atmosphere. Famous for margaritas and grilled meats.
restaurants.mustTry: Carne asada with all the fixings

restaurants.name: Zibu
restaurants.description: Japanese-fusion restaurant featuring premium sushi, sashimi, and innovative cooked dishes using local and imported ingredients. Intimate setting with sushi counter views.

restaurants.name: Grill Room at Hilton
restaurants.description: Steakhouse featuring prime cuts, fresh seafood, and an extensive wine list in an upscale resort setting. Elegant preparations and attentive service.
restaurants.mustTry: Pan-seared yellowfin tuna with ponzu reduction

activities.name: Snorkeling at Medano Beach
activities.description: Explore colorful coral reefs and tropical fish just offshore from the main beach. Equipment rental available on-site with minimal entry fees.

activities.name: Sportfishing Charter
activities.description: Half or full-day deep-sea fishing trips targeting marlin, dorado, wahoo, and roosterfish with experienced captains. All equipment and bait provided.

activities.name: Sunset Catamaran Cruise
activities.description: Sail to El Arco rock formation at sunset with onboard beverages and snacks, often including whale watching in season. Romantic and photogenic experience.

activities.name: Desert ATV & Zip Line Adventure
activities.description: Combine off-road ATV riding through scenic desert landscapes with multiple zip-line courses offering adrenaline and aerial views. Guided tours with safety equipment.

activities.name: El Arco Kayaking
activities.description: Paddle kayak around the iconic El Arco rock formation and explore sea caves and hidden beaches. Guided tours depart from Medano Beach.

activities.name: Golf at Championship Courses
activities.description: Play world-class golf courses like Cabo del Sol and Palmilla offering ocean views, challenging layouts, and professional services. Multiple courses available.

activities.name: Whale Watching Tour
activities.description: December through April, witness migrating gray whales and breaching humpbacks from dedicated boats with marine biologists. One of North America's best whale watching experiences.

activities.name: Medano Beach Relaxation & Swimming
activities.description: Enjoy the main sandy beach with calm waters, beach clubs, restaurants, and stunning sunset views. Free access with optional food and drink purchases.

activities.name: Spa & Wellness Treatments
activities.description: Indulge in massages, facials, and holistic treatments at luxury resort spas using local and organic products. Many spas offer oceanview treatment rooms.

activities.name: Downtown Cabo Walking Tour
activities.description: Explore the historic marina area, colonial architecture, local galleries, artisan shops, and authentic restaurants. Free self-guided or small fee for guided tours.

activities.name: Nightlife & Club Experience
activities.description: Experience vibrant nightclubs, beachfront bars, and live music venues throughout downtown Cabo and resort areas. Music ranges from DJ sets to traditional Mexican bands.

activities.name: Cabo Pulmo National Marine Sanctuary Dive
activities.description: Scuba dive in pristine coral reefs home to 200+ fish species and large pelagics, located 70km from Los Cabos. World-class dive site with experienced operators.

spots.name: El Arco (The Arch)
spots.description: Iconic rock formation at the meeting of the Pacific Ocean and Sea of Cortez, offering dramatic composition opportunities at sunrise and sunset.
spots.bestTime: Sunset for warm tones or early morning for cool light

spots.name: Medano Beach
spots.description: Sweeping sandy beach with colorful boats, beach clubs, and mountains in background, perfect for wide-angle landscape and lifestyle shots.
spots.bestTime: Golden hour for warm light, sunrise for solitude

spots.name: Lover's Beach
spots.description: Small intimate beach accessible by boat with turquoise waters, white sand, and dramatic rock formations creating intimate framing.
spots.bestTime: Mid-morning for soft light without harsh shadows

spots.name: Downtown Marina District
spots.description: Colonial-style buildings, boats, waterfront shops, and local life create dynamic street photography and cultural documentation opportunities.
spots.bestTime: Early morning for clean light and fewer crowds

spots.name: Flora Farms
spots.description: Farm gardens with organic produce and rustic architecture surrounded by desert landscape, offering nature and environmental storytelling.
spots.bestTime: Golden hour for warm garden tones

spots.name: Cerritos Beach
spots.description: Long sandy beach with consistent waves, surfboards, and dramatic desert backdrop, ideal for action sports and lifestyle photography.
spots.bestTime: Morning sessions for offshore light and surfer activity

spots.name: Todos Santos Art District
spots.description: Charming coastal town with colorful colonial buildings, street art, galleries, and local craftspeople creating vibrant cultural scenes.
spots.bestTime: Overcast days for even light on architecture

spots.name: San Jose del Cabo Market
spots.description: Local farmers market with colorful produce, flowers, crafts, and vibrant local activity offering authentic documentary and detail shots.
spots.bestTime: Early morning when vendors are setting up

spots.name: Shipwreck at Cerritos
spots.description: Abandoned wooden shipwreck remains on beach creating dramatic texture and historical storytelling with desert and ocean backdrops.
spots.bestTime: Low tide for full structure visibility, golden hour for mood

spots.name: Punta Colorada
spots.description: Red rock formations meeting turquoise water creating vibrant color contrasts and dramatic seascapes unique to the region.
spots.bestTime: Late afternoon when red rocks glow warmly

lensRecommendations: 16-35mm wide-angle for sweeping landscape shots of El Arco and beaches
70-200mm telephoto for compressed perspective of rock formations and wildlife
50mm prime for street photography in downtown and markets with natural bokeh
Macro lens for detail shots of coral, marine life, and local crafts
photography.goldenHourNotes: Los Cabos offers exceptional golden hour photography year-round with consistent warm light across both sunrise and sunset. The desert landscape intensifies golden hour colors, turning rocks and sand into warm amber tones, while the meeting of two bodies of water at El Arco creates dramatic reflections during these windows. Plan 30 minutes before and after official sunrise/sunset times for optimal shooting conditions.

weather.seasonality: Los Cabos experiences a desert climate with hot summers (June-September reaching 32-34°C) when hurricane season approaches and rainfall increases, making these months less ideal for travel. The optimal visiting season runs November through April when temperatures are pleasantly warm (20-25°C), rainfall minimal, and weather is most stable.
weather.summary: Los Cabos enjoys abundant sunshine year-round with minimal rainfall outside hurricane season (June-September). The region offers exceptional weather for beach and outdoor activities during the dry season, though summer months attract fewer visitors due to heat and occasional tropical storms.

hotels.name: Hotel California
hotels.description: Charming historic colonial-style hotel with colorful rooms, local art gallery, and restaurant in the artistic town of Todos Santos.

hotels.name: Pueblo Bonito Sunset Beach Resort & Spa
hotels.description: All-inclusive beachfront resort featuring multiple pools, restaurants, spa, water sports, and direct beach access with ocean views.

hotels.name: One&Only Palmilla
hotels.description: Ultra-luxury beachfront resort offering private beach access, Michelin-worthy dining, championship golf course, and world-class spa services.
